title: Bamfurlong
basis: Maggot's farm lies in the north Marish a few miles south-west of Stock; the hobbits walked from it to the Ferry lane before dark
hint: Farmer Maggot's farm in the Marish

title: Bucklebury Ferry
basis: the ferry crosses the Brandywine from the end of the Stock lane to the landing below Bucklebury and Brandy Hall
hint: ferry over the Brandywine between the Marish and Buckland

title: Three-Farthing Stone
basis: the stone marks where three Farthings meet, near the middle of the Shire, a short way south-west of Bywater
hint: standing stone near the centre of the Shire

title: South-gate of Bree
basis: the Road left Bree by a second gate on the south side of the village, toward Staddle and the east
hint: gate where the East Road leaves Bree

title: Lone-lands
basis: the empty country along the East Road between the Weather Hills and the Last Bridge on the Hoarwell
hint: wild empty land east of Weathertop

title: Clearing of the Stone-trolls
basis: the three trolls turned to stone stand in a clearing a short walk from their cave, north of the Road in the Trollshaws
hint: clearing where Bilbo's three trolls stand as stone

title: Ettenmoors
basis: troll-haunted fells north-west of Rivendell where the Hoarwell rises
hint: high moors north of the Trollshaws

title: Coldfells
basis: Appendix A puts the Coldfells north of Rivendell, where hill-trolls slew the Chieftain Arador
hint: cold uplands north of Rivendell

title: Redhorn Gate
basis: the pass runs under the side of Caradhras from Hollin to the Dimrill Stair
hint: high pass of the Misty Mountains under Caradhras

title: Naith of Lórien
basis: the Naith or Gore is the angle of land between the Silverlode and the Anduin, around and south-east of Caras Galadhon
hint: the heart of Lórien between Silverlode and Anduin

title: Durin's Stone
basis: a broken pillar on the path beside the Mirrormere in Dimrill Dale
hint: pillar where Durin first looked into the Mirrormere

title: Sarn Gebir
basis: rapids in the Anduin's gorge through the Emyn Muil, a few miles above the Argonath
hint: rapids of the Anduin north of the Argonath

title: East Wall of Rohan
basis: the cliff on the western edge of the Emyn Muil that the hunters climbed down onto the plains of Rohan
hint: western cliff of the Emyn Muil above Rohan

title: Eastemnet
basis: the open grasslands of Rohan east of the Entwash and south of the Wold
hint: eastern plains of Rohan

title: Westemnet
basis: the plains of Rohan west of the Entwash, between Edoras and Fangorn
hint: western plains of Rohan

title: Eastfold
basis: the fertile land of Rohan east of Edoras under the White Mountains
hint: land of Rohan east of Edoras

title: Westfold
basis: the vale of Rohan that lies before Helm's Deep, between the Isen and the White Mountains
hint: western vale of Rohan around Helm's Deep

title: Thrihyrne
basis: the three-horned peak at the head of the Deeping-coomb behind the Hornburg
hint: three-peaked mountain above Helm's Deep

title: Starkhorn
basis: the high snow peak at the head of Harrowdale, seen from Dunharrow
hint: great peak above Harrowdale

title: Dwimorberg
basis: the Haunted Mountain behind Dunharrow; the Dark Door is in its cliff
hint: the Haunted Mountain above the Paths of the Dead

title: Methedras
basis: the last peak at the southern end of the Misty Mountains, above Isengard; Treebeard's home lies on its eastern slopes
hint: southernmost peak of the Misty Mountains

title: Gap of Rohan
basis: the wide gap between the Misty and White Mountains, crossed by the Isen
hint: pass between the Misty and White Mountains

title: Treebeard's Hill
basis: a steep hill near the eastern eaves of Fangorn where Merry and Pippin met Treebeard
hint: hill in Fangorn where the hobbits met Treebeard

title: Mouths of Entwash
basis: the Entwash spreads in many channels through the fens before joining the Anduin
hint: marshy delta where the Entwash meets the Anduin

title: Min-Rimmon
basis: beacon hill between Erelas and Calenhad in the chain of beacons of Gondor
hint: beacon hill of Anórien

title: Snowmane's Howe
basis: the green mound raised over Théoden's horse on the Pelennor where he fell
hint: grave of Théoden's horse on the Pelennor

title: The Cross-roads
basis: where the Morgul road crosses the road south through Ithilien, west of the Morgul Vale; the headless statue of a king stood there
hint: road crossing in Ithilien with the statue of a fallen king

title: Forbidden Pool
basis: the pool below the falls of Henneth Annûn where Gollum was caught
hint: pool beneath Henneth Annûn

title: Pinnath Gelin
basis: the Green Hills of Gondor north of Anfalas and west of the Morthond
hint: green hills of western Gondor

title: Ethir Anduin
basis: the many mouths of the Anduin below Pelargir, where it enters the Bay of Belfalas east of Tolfalas
hint: delta of the Anduin

title: Dor-en-Ernil
basis: the Land of the Prince, the region of Belfalas around and inland from Dol Amroth
hint: land of the Prince of Dol Amroth

title: North Ithilien
basis: the northern part of Ithilien, from the Morgul Vale toward the Dead Marshes, where Faramir's Rangers hid
hint: northern half of Ithilien

title: South Ithilien
basis: the southern part of Ithilien between the Morgul Vale and the Poros
hint: southern half of Ithilien

title: Nurn
basis: the southern lands of Mordor around the Sea of Núrnen, farmed by slaves
hint: slave-farmed south of Mordor

title: Noman-lands
basis: the waste land between the Brown Lands, the Emyn Muil and the Dead Marshes
hint: barren land north of the Dead Marshes

title: Desolation of Smaug
basis: the burned land around the Lonely Mountain, between Dale and the Long Lake
hint: wasteland around Erebor

title: Gollum's Lake
basis: the dark lake deep under the Misty Mountains, below Goblin-town and near the back door, where Bilbo found the Ring
hint: underground lake where Gollum lived

title: East Bight
basis: a great inlet of open land cut into the eastern edge of Mirkwood
hint: clearing cut into the east side of Mirkwood

title: Éothéod
basis: the northern land of Eorl's people between the Langwell and the Greylin, with Framsburg
hint: former land of the Rohirrim in the far north

title: The Angle
basis: the land between the Hoarwell and the Loudwater where Stoors once lived
hint: land between Hoarwell and Loudwater

title: House of Tom Bombadil
basis: at the eastern edge of the Old Forest, below the Barrow-downs, at the end of a day's walk down the Withywindle
hint: Tom Bombadil's house at the edge of the Old Forest

title: Westfarthing
basis: the western quarter of the Shire, with Hobbiton and Michel Delving
hint: western Farthing of the Shire

title: Northfarthing
basis: the northern quarter of the Shire, with Oatbarton and Long Cleeve
hint: northern Farthing of the Shire

title: Eastfarthing
basis: the eastern quarter of the Shire, with Frogmorton, Whitfurrows and the Marish
hint: eastern Farthing of the Shire

title: Southfarthing
basis: the southern quarter of the Shire, with Longbottom and its pipe-weed
hint: southern Farthing of the Shire

title: Buckland
basis: the land of the Brandybucks between the Brandywine and the High Hay
hint: land of the Brandybucks east of the Brandywine

title: Tookland
basis: the country of the Tooks around Tuckborough in the Green Hills
hint: home country of the Tooks

title: Bridgefields
basis: the farmlands of the Eastfarthing near the Brandywine Bridge, around Budgeford
hint: farmland west of the Brandywine Bridge

title: Westmarch
basis: the land between the Far Downs and the Tower Hills added to the Shire by King Elessar; Undertowers is its seat
hint: western addition to the Shire

title: Harlindon
basis: the southern part of Lindon, south of the Gulf of Lune
hint: Lindon south of the Gulf of Lune

title: Forlindon
basis: the northern part of Lindon, north of the Gulf of Lune
hint: Lindon north of the Gulf of Lune

title: Drúwaith Iaur
basis: the Old Púkel-land, wild hills north of the cape of Andrast between the Isen mouth and the Lefnui
hint: old wild land of the Drúedain

title: Amon Darthir
basis: a peak of Ered Wethrin that rose south of Húrin's house in Dor-lómin
hint: mountain above Húrin's home

title: Nen Lalaith
basis: the stream from a spring under Amon Darthir that ran past Húrin's house
hint: stream beside Húrin's house in Dor-lómin

title: Annon-in-Gelydh
basis: the hidden gate of the Noldor in the western hills of Dor-lómin; its tunnel came out in Cirith Ninniach
hint: Gate of the Noldor that Tuor found

title: Caves of Androth
basis: caves in the hills of Mithrim where Tuor was fostered by Annael
hint: caves where Tuor grew up

title: Dry River
basis: the dry bed of the stream that once flowed out of Tumladen; it led to the hidden gate of Gondolin near the Brithiach
hint: dry river-bed of the hidden way to Gondolin

title: Cairn of Fingolfin
basis: Thorondor carried Fingolfin's body to a peak on the north of the Encircling Mountains, and Turgon raised a cairn there
hint: cairn of the High King on the mountains of Gondolin

title: Cairn of Glorfindel
basis: the Eagles raised a cairn over Glorfindel beside Cirith Thoronath where he fell with the Balrog
hint: cairn of Glorfindel in the Eagles' Cleft

title: Stone of the Hapless
basis: the mound and stone of Túrin and Nienor above the gorge of Cabed-en-Aras
hint: grave of Túrin and Nienor

title: Celebros
basis: the stream in Brethil that falls over Nen Girith into the Teiglin
hint: stream of Brethil above the Teiglin

title: Haudh-en-Arwen
basis: the green mound of Lady Haleth in the heights of Brethil
hint: the Ladybarrow, grave of Haleth

title: Hírilorn
basis: the greatest beech of Neldoreth, where Thingol shut Lúthien in a house in the branches
hint: great beech where Lúthien was imprisoned

title: Girdle of Melian
basis: Melian's unseen fence of enchantment round Neldoreth and Region; the point lies on its northern edge
hint: magic fence around Doriath

title: Little Gelion
basis: the western arm of Gelion, rising in the hills of Himring
hint: western source-arm of Gelion

title: Greater Gelion
basis: the eastern arm of Gelion, rising on Mount Rerir
hint: eastern source-arm of Gelion

title: Dor Firn-i-Guinar
basis: the Land of the Dead that Live in southern Ossiriand, around Tol Galen, where Beren and Lúthien dwelt
hint: land of Beren and Lúthien after their return

title: Dor-Cúarthol
basis: the Land of Bow and Helm, held by Túrin and Beleg from Amon Rûdh
hint: land defended by Túrin and Beleg
